concept.title: Lasagna Coke
concept.description: A limited-edition Coca-Cola-inspired novelty cola with savory flavor notes associated with lasagna: tomato sauce, ricotta and mozzarella cheese, basil, garlic, herbs, and bolognese. It is sold in a brightly illustrated collectible can and positioned as an intentionally strange, conversation-starting product for adventurous consumers and fans of unusual limited editions.

panel.name: Adventurous Foodie 1
panel.description: Seeks out unusual flavor pairings and enjoys describing them to others.

panel.name: Mainstream Drinker 1
panel.description: Sticks with a few trusted soft drinks and rarely switches brands.

panel.name: Skeptical Health-Conscious 1
panel.description: Reads labels closely and distrusts marketing claims on new beverages.

panel.name: Adventurous Foodie 2
panel.description: Buys limited-edition and international products mainly to see what they taste like.

panel.name: Mainstream Drinker 2
panel.description: Chooses whatever is familiar, cold, and on promotion at the store.

panel.name: Skeptical Health-Conscious 2
panel.description: Avoids artificial additives and wants clear evidence a product is worth it.

panel.name: Adventurous Foodie 3
panel.description: Treats drinks as a tasting experience; bored by anything too familiar.

panel.name: Mainstream Drinker 3
panel.description: Will try a new flavor occasionally if it sounds like a normal drink.

panel.name: Skeptical Health-Conscious 3
panel.description: Open to novelty only when ingredients are simple and the benefit is explained.

panel.name: Adventurous Foodie 4
panel.description: Likes savory-meets-sweet experiments but wants them to be well executed.

panel.name: Mainstream Drinker 4
panel.description: Drinks soda socially and does not think much about ingredients.

panel.name: Skeptical Health-Conscious 4
panel.description: Sees novelty drinks as gimmicks unless they replace something less healthy.
